items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Not really, really well, but I knew him enough to know – if I saw him, I’d say, “Hi Web.”

ctx.x: You mentioned Freddie Webster. Did you know Freddie Webster?
Not really, really well, but I knew him enough to know – if I saw him, I’d say, “Hi Web.”
He has a kind of a – he’s sort of a minor myth in jazz.
